festivals.what: Ok Wa Festival (end of Buddhist Lent, called Ok Wa by the Shan, or Tai Yai, community): in 2026 held 25 to 27 October at Wat Utthayarom (Wat Jong Sung), Mae Sariang District, celebrating the Shan community's Ok Wa traditions. The date follows the lunar calendar.
